rate_limit_test: 80 requests in a burst on a key limited to 50 per minute
note: Real HTTP calls to uvicorn on one 2-core machine, latency measured by the client including HTTP. 1 worker: 121 req/s, p95 89.4 ms · 2 workers: 279 req/s, p95 51.6 ms. Throughput grows with workers or pods (scoring is CPU-bound and stateless apart from the history). Rate limit (single worker): a key limited to 50/min got HTTP 429 for 30 of 80 burst requests; no key gives 401. With several workers the limiter is per process, so in production it belongs in the API gateway or Redis.
